limitationTriage.limitation: Priority holds only within a bounded search.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Has a canonical-basis counterexample or the criterion been stated elsewhere?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Dated searches of 1 and 3 November 2026 (novelty audit, review searches, GitHub corpus check); no subscription-database search; no author enquiry.
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Exhaustive search and author enquiry out of scope; disclosed in the paper and README.
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: Requires specialist databases and contact with the authors.

limitationTriage.limitation: Oracle prior covariance, one analysis step, Gaussian ensemble; no cycling, model error or operational data.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does the advantage persist with estimated covariances and cycling?
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: Beyond the scope of this release; listed as open problems.

limitationTriage.limitation: Conjecture 5.4 and Open problem 8.2 are numerical only.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can the sign property and zeta > 0 be proved?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Grids of 660 cases and 14 x 31 x 2 cases.
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Stated as conjecture and open problem in the paper.

limitationTriage.limitation: The testbed is a reconstruction from the text, not a replication of the published figures.
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Sensitivity to correlation scale and observation count (Section 10.4).

limitationTriage.limitation: Verification scripts used assert, wrote in place and had a hard-coded status (review objection).
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Do the checks fail under -O and leave shipped results untouched?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Explicit checks with computed status, --out to new directories, negative controls; -O reruns identical.

limitationTriage.limitation: The canonical side was not allowed variance inflation (review objection).
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does a rotation still win against inflated canonical tapers?
